cause: tokenizer.json was missing after an earlier metadata download timeout; TokenizersBackend silently constructed a one-token vocabulary. Ordinary prompts encoded as [1].
responsibility: The model weights were verified, but tokenizer readiness was not checked before the pilot. This was a preflight omission.
interpretation: Control-token garbage is not evidence of Qwen3.5 language quality. No generated record admitted to training.
fix: Download and verify tokenizer.json; assert nontrivial vocabulary and model EOS consistency before retry in a new directory.
